_doc: Single source of truth for token budgets. Change weekly_allocation (or a class cap) here; every phase budget and card cap derives from it. plan_lint reads this file. Chosen by the planner 2026-10-21 (DEC-001, [Inferred]); the 3-card pilot replaces class caps with measured p90 x 1.2. Weekly spend = weekly_allocation x (1 - reserve_share), split between the active phases in proportion to phase_weights (Stage 2 fix: the old phase_shares summed to 1.28 and had no Phase 7). 'prep' is G2 readiness + Oracle sessions for the next phase.
unit: cost-weighted tokens = uncached input + output + 0.1 x cache-read input, as summed from the Cursor usage view per role session
xl_only_for: elite design cards (App Studio Pack, audits)
